summary: Biologists spot young fish using the channel that crews reopened at {place}.
realLife: King County reported that biologists saw juvenile salmon in restored habitat after construction at Fall City.
gates: A completed restoration connects fish habitat and a field survey has taken place.
weights: More observation periods improve the chance of detecting returning fish.
inGame: needs: field observations by species and survey date.

turns.what: The first survey finds no young fish in the restored channel.
turns.pulledBy: Biologists complete the survey without a sighting.
turns.writesBack: The field log records the survey effort and zero sightings.

turns.what: Young fish appear on the next survey.
turns.pulledBy: A later observation follows a change in river level.
turns.writesBack: The survey record gives the date of the first sighting.
